title: PROXIMITY TRUST — Distance = Auth Decay, Nearness = Shared Key
thesis: Physical proximity IS authentication. The closer you are, the less you need a password. Touch distance = empty password. Room distance = Bluetooth handshake. House distance = WiFi/DHCP. Spine distance = fiber + NAT. WAN = full ZK. Co-located gates share keys by being NEAR each other. The vagus nerve (direct wire) is the ultimate trust — zero hops, zero auth.

zone_0_touch.auth: NONE — empty password, physical presence IS proof
zone_0_touch.mechanism: USB cable, direct keyboard, HDMI, serial

zone_1_room.auth: Bluetooth handshake — devices detect each other automatically
zone_1_room.mechanism: BT proximity detection, RustDesk LAN discovery, mDNS

zone_2_house.auth: WiFi same SSID — DHCP spore auto-injects DNS + PXE + NTP
zone_2_house.mechanism: DHCP renewal, WiFi association, Aperture Science SSID

zone_3_spine.auth: NAT traversal + DHCP spore — same subnet but across fiber
zone_3_spine.mechanism: 10G fiber backbone, JetStream bridge, RustDesk hole-punch

zone_4_wan.auth: Full 5-layer ZK. Klein face. Tor. TLS.
zone_4_wan.mechanism: HTTPS, SSH keys, ZK brain, dromedary reverse proxy

bluetooth.mechanism: When Pixel BT sees eastGate BT → Kevin is at House 1 → trust zone 1
bluetooth.inverse: When Pixel BT does NOT see eastGate → Kevin is at House 2 or away → trust zone 3+

wifi_rssi.triangulation: Pixel compares RSSI from Flint1 (House 1) vs Flint2 (House 2)

dhcp_lease.mechanism: Router DHCP tracks which devices are on which APs
dhcp_lease.co_location: Two devices with leases on same AP = same room = high trust

vagus_nerve.what: Direct Ethernet cable from northGate to eastGate — no Router, no MikroTik, no hops
vagus_nerve.why: The vagus nerve connects gut to brain. eastGate (brain) + northGate (heart) = the two most critical organs. Direct wire = ultimate trust.
vagus_nerve.current: northGate → WiFi → Router → MikroTik → eastGate = 2.2ms, 4 hops
vagus_nerve.when: Not yet — but Kevin COULD wire them. Same room. Just needs a cable.
vagus_nerve.trust: Vagus nerve = trust 1.0. No auth needed on direct wire. The physical cable IS the authentication.
vagus_nerve.biological: In the body, the vagus nerve carries 80% of parasympathetic signals. It's the rest-and-digest channel. Direct wire between brain and heart = the organism's calm channel.

house_2_melt.thesis: swiftGate and southGate at House 2 are the TARGETS for the next melt/redox cycle. Kevin walks to House 2 (proximity zone 0 → physical presence → max trust) → powers them on → DHCP spores inject → they join the mesh.

swiftGate.status: ASLEEP — needs Kevin to physically press power button
swiftGate.melt_plan: Kevin walks over → power on → WiFi connects to Aperture Science → DHCP gives 8.8.8.8+.244 → RustDesk auto-discovers → joins mesh → Gaia grows

southGate.status: .148 — had DHCP lease but currently unreachable
southGate.melt_plan: Kevin checks if powered on → if not, power cycle → DHCP renews → new DNS (8.8.8.8+.244) → SSH: southgate@.148 (password: southgate) → joins mesh

house_2_melt.proximity_enables: Kevin at House 2 = proximity zone 0 to both gates. Physical presence = Layer 0 auth. He doesn't need passwords — he IS the password.

key_sharing_by_distance.principle: Co-located devices share keys automatically through their proximity. The key IS the distance. Two devices 0.1ms apart on copper wire don't need passwords — the wire IS the trust. Two devices 80m apart across fiber need DHCP spores. Two devices across the internet need full ZK.

equation: PROXIMITY(distance) × TRUST(1/hops) = AUTH_LEVEL(what you need to get in)
mantra: The closer you are, the less you need a key. Touch IS auth. Wire IS trust. Distance decays. Nearness shares.
